text: All-on-4 Dental Implants in McLean, VA

Four implants carry a whole upper or lower arch, and in most cases you leave the McLean office the same day with fixed provisional teeth. Dr. Esam Nahlah plans the arch on a cone-beam scan and places it at Suite 220, 7901 Jones Branch Drive.
Three things every All-on-4 patient gets.
A working provisional arch, screwed in place before you leave. Nobody goes home without teeth.
Five years on the implant work, conditional on Precare: a cleaning every six months, the interval any set of teeth needs.
Already holding an All-on-4 quote from somewhere else? Bring it and the scan; reviewing it here costs nothing.
How an arch comes together in McLean.
Cone-beam imaging of the jaw shows whether four implants will hold, or whether grafting is needed first. Price, insurance and financing are on the table at this visit.
Teeth that cannot be saved come out, where the case allows on the same day the implants go in, by the same specialist.
Four implants go in through a printed guide, the back two tilted toward denser bone, and the provisional arch is fitted before you go home.
Three to four months on, the final zirconia arch replaces the provisional, and the gum keeps healing around it for two to four months more.
Each case shows both jaws restored, before and after.

faq: How much does All-on-4 cost in McLean?

It depends on whether one arch or both are restored, whether grafting is needed, and the material of the final arch: a zirconia arch is not the same object as an acrylic one. Your figure is set at the consultation, and financing reaches $60,000 over terms of up to 96 months.
Can both arches be done at once?
Yes: upper, lower or both. When both are restored, the practice calls the case a double arch.
Will I have teeth when I leave the office?
In most cases, yes: a fixed provisional arch goes in on implant day and stays while the implants integrate.
What sedation is offered for All-on-4 in McLean?
Nitrous oxide or oral sedation, given by the practice's own team; IV sedation is not offered. Plan a ride both ways after oral sedation.
